content: Mbla Ámʋ Ɩtráa ma Túmi Akristofɔsʋ
Mɩ́ apíó, mlɩ fɛ́ɛ́ mlɩyin Mose Mbla ámʋ. Mlɩyin ánɩ́ brɛ́á ɔha tsie nkpa á, ɔbʋ mbla asɩ.
Fɛ́ nɩ́ ɔtsɩ tsia okúlu, mʋ kulu amʋ mɔ́kʋ́wú á, ɔbʋ mʋ kulu amʋ asɩ. Támɛ nɩ́ mʋ kulu amʋ owú a, alagyi ɩwɩ, okúlu wóyí mbla kʋkʋ ɩtráa mɛdɛ́ mʋ.
Mʋ́ alɩ sʋ nɩ́ mʋ kulu amʋ mɔ́kʋ́nyá wú, ɔdálɩ mʋ ɔma a, alatɔ́ mbʋa. Támɛ nɩ́ mʋ kulu amʋ owú mʋ́ á, ɔtráa ɔma okúlu wóyí mbla asɩ. Mʋ́ sʋ nɩ́ ɔláyétsiá oyin bámbá á, ɔmɔkʋ́tɔ́ mbʋa.

Mɩ́ apíó, alɩ kɛ́n igyi há mlɩ nɩ́. Mlɩ ɛ́ brɛ́á mlɩlɔ́hɔ Kristo gyi a, mlɩa mʋnyɔ mlɩlówu. Mʋ́ sʋ mlɩtráa mlɩmá Mose Mbla asɩ. Séi á, mlɩlabwɛ́ ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu lɔ́kʋsʋ́a tsu afúlitɔ ámʋ klɛ́, mɛ́nɩ mlɔ́bwɛ yilé há Bulu.
Tsúfɛ́ brɛ́á anɩbʋ anɩ tsiátɔ́ dada amʋtɔ á, mbla ámʋ lɛ́ha anɩ ɔwɔ́lɩ laláhɛ legyi anɩsʋ. Mʋ́ sʋ anɩlɔ́bwɛ tɔ́á ɩtɔpʋ́ lowu ba.

Támɛ séi mʋ́ á, Bulu lahá anɩlagyi ɩwɩ tsú mbla ámʋ́ʋ́ tɛkɩ anɩbʋ mʋ́ asɩ ámʋ ɩbɩtɔ. Anɩa Kristonyɔ lówu. Mʋ́ sʋ mbla ámʋ ɩtráa ma túmi anɩsʋ. Anɩlagyi ɩwɩ, anɩdɛ́ Bulu súm tsʋn ɔkpa pɔpwɛ ánɩ́ Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ dɛ́ anɩ sunásʋ́. Megyí ɔkpa ánɩ́ mbla wánlɩ́nhɛ́ amʋ lósuná anɩsʋ.
Mbla Ámʋ Mʋ́a Lakpanbwɛ

Mʋ́ sʋ anɩdɛ́blɩ́ anɩaa, ɩtɔ laláhɛ Mose Mbla ámʋ gyí? Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ! Mbla ámʋ ɩbɛ́ha abɛ́bɩ tɔ́á lakpan gyí. Tɛkɩ nɩ́ mbla ámʋ ɩmɛblɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mápɛ ansɩ́ fʋ́ bá atɔ́sʋ́” a, tɛkɩ mmɛbɩ tɔ́á gyí ɔnsɩ́pɛ.
Ɩna alɩ mbla ánfɩ sʋ lakpan lénya ɔkpa pʋ́ ɔnsɩ́pɛ kugyíkʋ wá mɩ́tɔ́. Tsúfɛ́ nɩ́ mbla ámʋ má ɩnʋ á, tɛkɩ lakpan má túmi mɩ́sʋ́.
Mɩ́ onutó netsiá brɛ́ kʋtɔ, mmɛbɩ mbla ámʋ. Támɛ brɛ́á nɛbɛbɩ mʋ́ á, nowun ánɩ́ napán mʋ́sʋ́. Lakpan ɔbwɛpʋ́ ngyi. Mʋ́ sʋ nówu.
Nowun ánɩ́ mbla ámʋ́ʋ́ nkɩ mbɛ́ɛ, ɩbɛ́ha mɩ́ nkpa ámʋ lɔ́pʋ lowu ba mɩ.
Tsúfɛ́ lakpan lénya ɔkpa tsʋn mbla ámʋsʋ mlɛ́ mɩ́, mɔ́ mɩ́.
Tsiátɔ́ mbla ámʋ mʋ́ á, tsitsa kʋkʋ ma mʋ́ ɩwɩ. Mʋ́ nhɩhɩɛ́ kugyíkʋ lɔwankɩ́, ɩda ɔkpa, ɩbʋ alɛ́ ɛ́.

Mʋ́ sʋ idesuná ánɩ́ Bulu mbla ánfɩ́ ɩbʋ alɛ́ ánfɩ lɔ́pʋ lowu ba mɩ? Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ! Megyí alɩ ígyi. Lakpan lɔ́tsʋn ɩtɔ wankláán ámʋsʋ pʋ́ lowu ba mɩ. Ɩna mbla ámʋsʋ lakpan lɛ́lɛ ɩwɩ súná ánɩ́ itépí ma alɛ.
Atɔ́á Ɩdɛkɔ Nyankpʋsatɔ
Anɩyin ánɩ́ ɔŋɛ́tɔ́ atɔ́ mbla ámʋ gyí, támɛ mɩ́ mʋ́ á, nyankpʋsa ngyi. Nabwɛ́ lakpan ɔkpábi.
Mmɛtálɩ́ bɩ́ mɩ́ tsiátɔ́, tsúfɛ́ megyí tɔ́á ndeklé ntɔbwɛ́, tɔ́á mmedéklé mboún ntɔbwɛ́.
Nɩ́ tɔ́á mmedéklé ndɛbwɛ mʋ́ á, natsúlá ánɩ́ Mose Mbla ámʋ ɩbʋ alɛ́.
Idesuná ánɩ́ megyí mɩ́ dɛ́ alɩ atɔ́ ánfɩ bwɛ. Mboún lakpan túmiá ɩbʋ mɩsʋ tɛ́há ntɔbwɛ́ mʋ́.
Nyin ánɩ́ brɛ́ ánfɩ mbʋ mɩ́ tsiátɔ́ dada anfɩtɔ á, ɩtɔ wankláán kʋkʋ má mɩ́tɔ́, tsúfɛ́ nyankpʋsa ngyi. Ntekleá nɔ́bwɛ yilé, támɛ nakásíán.
Mmɛdɛ́ yiléá ndeklé bwɛ. Lalahɛ amʋ́ʋ́ mmedékléá nɔ́bwɛ ámʋ mboún ndɛbwɛ.
Nɩ́ ndɛ lalahɛ amʋ́ʋ́ mmedékléá nɔ́bwɛ ámʋ bwɛ á, mʋ́mʋ́ idesuná ánɩ́ megyí mɩ́ onutó dɛ́ mʋ́ bwɛ. Mboún lakpan túmi ámʋ́ʋ́ ɩbʋ mɩtɔ ámʋ dɛ́ mʋ́ bwɛ.
Mʋ́ sʋ nawun ánɩ́ mbla ánfɩ lagyi mɩsʋ. Nɩ́ ndekléá nɔ́bwɛ yilé á, lalahɛ kóún ntɔbwɛ́.
Tsúfɛ́ nhɩ́ɛ́ ndekléá négyi Bulu mbla ámʋsʋ tsú mɩ́ klʋntɔ.
Támɛ ntowun ánɩ́ mbla kʋ dɛ́ mbla ámʋ́ʋ́ ɩbʋ mɩ́ klʋntɔ ámʋ ɩsá kɔ, gyi mʋ́sʋ́, bwɛ́ mɩ́ lakpan ɔkpábi. Ɩlahá lakpan ámʋ́ʋ́ ɩbʋ mɩtɔ ámʋ ɩdɛ mɩ́ bwɛhɛ́ kugyíkʋsʋ gyí.
Kɩ ipian kpɔnkpɔɔnkpɔntɩá mbʋ mʋ́tɔ́! Ɩlapʋ́ mɩ́ ɩya lowutɔ. Ma ɔbɛ́lɛ mɩ́ tsú mʋ́tɔ́?

Támɛ anɩ Wíe Yesu Kristo sʋ ndɛ Bulu ɩpán da ánɩ́ alalɛ́ mɩ́! Mɩ́ klʋntɔ mʋ́ á, tɛkɩ ndekléá nɔ́bwɛ Bulu mbla ámʋ ɔkpábi. Támɛ tsiátɔ́ laláhɛ amʋ́ʋ́ ɩbʋ mɩtɔ ámʋ lahá nabwɛ́ lakpan ɔkpábi mboún.
